Must-Know
Industrial power adapter and optical module are NOT included in both the packing box and unit pricing.

All models are Realtek Chip based. 
It ONLY supports adding client’s model name in GUI interface(free of cost, MoQ 1pc).
MoQ is 50pcs for adding Logo in GUI interface(free of cost).

L2 Models are Fully Gigabit based, not supporting 2.5G optical speed.

All PoE models support 2*BT ports and 2*PD voltage detection(24V or 48V).
This is extremely useful in high-PoE or passive-PoE projects.
